decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a component close to the firm's core air-cooler business and complement its service-driven lifecycle offer, so with growing industry turnover and slack from hiring, there is no shortfall against aspiration that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes reinforce the firm's efficiency and sustainability promise and fit its in-house R&D strength, so despite missing recent website evidence and the earlier pruning of sibling products, management is likely to carry it as part of the established offer.
